finding: A home reassignment executed before tactical task handling cancelled valid support and return orders, changed assignment during action locks, and delayed new departures when a previous-life defend task had not yet been cleaned.
reproduction: Home bot at (-56,0), ally at (-45,0), observed foe at (-43,0). A real support task begins. After the ally dies and enemy lane 0 opens, the old hook cancelled support; the fixed hook retains lane 1 and attack target 4.
fix: Move ordinary reassignment after lifecycle cleanup, busy/stun, recovery, own-core defense and active-kind branches. During completed home recovery only, clear the old retreat task, consider reassignment at the existing 85% threshold, then call the unchanged legacy hero branch to release retreat and depart.

real_scenarios: existing support attack after ally death
84% to 85% real base healing at forward boundary

additional_checks.original_review_reproducer: Both policies retain lane 1, objective support, attack target 4 and zero redeployments.

measurement_note: Earlier 486.633/1081.333/930.467-second product runs predate this priority fix. Parent-run final source-hashed matches and full regression are the release evidence.
